candidate_windows.window_text: All experiments are conducted on GeForce GTX 1080Ti. For finetuning, we use batch size 32 and 4 GPUs. Because prompting uses the masked language model objective so we use a maximum batch size 24. A single GPU is used for 1-shot experiments. Two and three GPUs are used for 2- and 4-shot experiments. Other experiments use 6 GPUs.

We use the same learning rate (1e-5) as Le Scao and Rush (2021) who compare prompting and finetuning in English NLU tasks. No learning rate scheduling is used for clear comparisons. For both finetuning and prompting, the model is trained for 50 epochs and the checkpoint that performs best on development set is selected for performance evaluation.
